D5/S3/Observer/Agency/PublicRecoveryCrit.name: D5.S3.Observer.Agency.PublicRecoveryCriterion.public_recovery_criterion
D5/S3/Observer/Agency/PublicRecoveryCrit.signature: theorem public_recovery_criterion {Control Public Hidden Ledger : Type*} [AddGroup Control] [AddGroup Public] [AddGroup Hidden] [AddGroup Ledger] (H : Control →+ Public) (K : Control →+ Hidden) (L : Control →+ Ledger) : ((∃ recover : H.range →+ Hidden, K = recover.comp H.rangeRestrict) ↔ H.ker ≤ K.ker) ∧ (H.ker ≤ K.ker ↔ H.ker.map K = ⊥) ∧ (H.ker.map K = ⊥ ↔ ∃ recover : H.range →+ Hidden, K = recover.comp H.rangeRestrict) ∧ (H.ker ⊓ L.ker).map K ≤ H.ker.map K
